wholePhysicalScope: Named native four-corner outline at 26 Yanping South Road; municipal descriptions establish a public stone arcade, upper timber floor, and three-dormer mansard.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the stone arches and three-dormer roof. Nearby levels add stone joints, shutter rails, timber casings and arcade openings.
limitations: The exterior represents the restored mansion at 26 Yanping South Road as it reopened in 2009. The model covers the named building and public street arcade.

The municipal description establishes the sandstone arches, timber upper floor, washed aggregate, copper mansard and three dormers. Exact roof pitches, profiles, sash arrangement and side and rear elevations are estimated.
The original elevation field is preserved. The rendered sidewalk, thresholds and column feet have approximate grade registration.
